description: Fight as Heart, an innocent robot fighting to escape the grip of mindless machines in a future where humans are no more. A fast-paced 3D brawler with roguelike elements set in a colorful yet desolated world.
name: Heart & Slash

objectives.co_op_rules: Flip primary objectives equal to the # of players, everyone must complete a primary objective with the flipped secondary objective
objectives.versus_tertiary: Most buckets at end of run
